name: videoforge-desktop
description: VideoForge - YouTube temizleyici & seslendirici masaustu uygulamasi
author: VideoForge

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && npm run build:smoke && electron dist-smoke/smoke.cjs
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test:bot && npm run test:smoke
